items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: She said, I know, Joe, you tired. I said, yes, ma'am, I am tired.

ctx.x: They really go, yeah. They march. And they got there, they say, we play St. Louis Blues. We figure I make them slack up. Man, St. Louis Blues look like they're right on top of it. Man, dude, I just look at that and I say, no more dealing with the soldiers. She didn't have to ask me one time, do y'all care for something, Nick? Do we care for something, Nick? Man, they had a trough where they had water where they put horses full of it. She said, you always going to help yourself. She said, I know, Joe, you tired. I…
The inside was dry. Yeah, yeah, sure.
